episodes.synopsis: Moroha begins classes at the Akane Academy because he has inherited mystical powers from a former life. While there he meets Satsuki and Shizuno, two girls who immediately find themselves drawn to him for various reasons.
episodes.title: The Reincarnater

episodes.synopsis: Moroha and Shizuno join the Strikers. Satsuki is frustrated by her lack of ability, but one weekend, she faces down a Metaphysical at the shopping mall.
episodes.title: Dwell within My Sword, Magic Flame

episodes.synopsis: Edward, one of the six Rank S Saviors, comes to Japan. Meanwhile, Shizuno refuses to talk about her past life, causing friction between her and Moroha.
episodes.title: The Netherworld Sorceress

episodes.synopsis: When Shizuno's brother tries to bully her into studying abroad, Moroha intervenes by revealing that he defeated the Dreadnought Class Metaphysical without any assistance. This leads to a high-stakes duel between himself and Sir Edward.
episodes.title: White Knight Assault

episodes.synopsis: The Strikers go to a small island for a summer training camp, and Satsuki takes it upon herself to become a faster, more capable Savior. Meanwhile, the Head Six are preparing to meet regarding Moroha's suggested promotion to rank S.
episodes.title: We Are the Summer

episodes.synopsis: A gigantic Metaphysical attacks just as the summer training camp is drawing to a close. Some members of the Head Six doubt Moroha's abilities, and they see this attack as the perfect opportunity to force him to prove himself in battle.
episodes.title: We Are the Swords of Salvation"

episodes.synopsis: A new student arrives from Russia on exchange, immediately confessing her feelings towards Moroha. Moroha is accommodating, but Shizuno has suspicions.
episodes.title: The Silver-haired Stranger

episodes.synopsis: Lesya's true identity is revealed: she is a maneater -- an assassin. As they take swings at each other, Moroha's holy sword awakens.
episodes.title: The Magic Sword and the Holy Sword

episodes.synopsis: Moroha challenges the Russia division to a fight on Lesya's behalf. With Edward's support, they arrive in Russia.
episodes.title: Siberian line

episodes.synopsis: With some help from his friends, Moroha finally faces the Russian Terror on her home turf. But when her Dark Arts turn out to be as powerful as his, it's unclear who will emerge victorious in this clash of titans.
episodes.title: Battle at Yekaterinburg

episodes.synopsis: The emergence of a Metaphysical delays Moroha's departure from Russia. Little does anyone realize, a dark specter from his former lives is about to reappear in Japan, forcing everyone there to face it without his aid. The Metaphysical destroys everything in sight. Moraha gets informed about the Metaphysical and remembers both of his past lifes discovering that he lost both of the people he loved by the Metaphysical.
episodes.title: The Nightmare from a Former Life

episodes.synopsis: The Saviors fight valiantly in what appears to be a losing battle against an unusually intelligent Metaphysical. When Moroha finally enters the fray, he finds it will take more than his powers alone to emerge victorious.
episodes.title: Surpass Two Lives
